description.zh:
检查项ID。

> 执行云产品配置检查任务，需要提供检查项的ID，该ID可调用[DescribeRiskItemType](~~DescribeRiskItemType~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The IDs of the check items.

> To perform a check task on cloud service configurations, you must specify the ID of the check item. You can call the [DescribeRiskItemType](~~DescribeRiskItemType~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值包括：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
The source IP address of the request.

description.zh:
检查的任务类型。取值包括：

- **check**：执行检测
- **verify**：执行验证
description.en:
The type of the check task. Valid values:

- **check**

- **verify**

title.zh: 执行云产品配置检查任务

descriptions.zh: 该接口已下线，使用升级接口SubmitCheck替换。
descriptions.en: This API operation is deprecated. Use SubmitCheck instead.
